headline: Steady quarter as full-year guidance narrows to the top half
summary_short: Adjusted EPS rose 6% to $2.00 while GAAP EPS was flat at $1.94. 2026 adjusted EPS guidance narrows to $6.07-$6.12 and 2027 standalone guidance is $6.53-$6.63.
summary_long: New rates took effect in Pennsylvania and New Jersey during the third quarter. The 2026 capital investment plan of $3.7B is on track, and about 81,000 customer connections were added from acquisitions through September. The proposed merger with Essential Utilities has three state approvals and settlements in Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Texas; closing is expected by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
confidence_notes: The release does not state revenue in the portion read; revenue is omitted. Adjusted EPS is non-GAAP and excludes weather, merger transaction costs and HOS seller-note interest.

drivers.explanation: The release cites regulatory execution, with new rates in effect in Pennsylvania and New Jersey in the third quarter.
Merger transaction costs of $0.04 per share and a weather adjustment of $0.04 sit between GAAP and adjusted EPS.
CEO says key regulatory outcomes provide reasonable and timely returns on investments and that the Essential Utilities merger is on track for first-quarter 2027.
